server_description: Open-source cooperative platform to end poverty and unite humanity.

features._comment: The capability manifest: what this server offers. EVERY feature defaults to true, so a server that has no features block (or is missing a key) behaves exactly as it did before this block existed - upgrading changes nothing. Set one to false and the relay REFUSES that feature's endpoints with HTTP 403 and rejects its WebSocket message types; it is not merely hidden in the client. Always served regardless: /health, /api/stats, /api/peers, /api/members, /api/server-info, /api/profile, identity and moderation - an owner cannot lock themselves out of their own box. The live manifest is published on /api/server-info so clients hide what they cannot use. Details: docs/admin/SELF-HOSTING.md.
